newsitem.title: USA: Motorola, Sourcecom in xDSL technology pact.
newsitem.headline: Motorola, Sourcecom in xDSL technology pact.

text.p: Motorola Inc's semiconductor division, and Sourcecom, a developer of high-speed modem semiconductor technology, agreed to a technology sharing pact as part of a strategic alliance, the companies said on Monday.
The companies said the deal was aimed at creating an industry standard for interoperability to make high-speed modems based on on Digital Subscriber Line (xDSL) technology.

The pact would lead to a reference design based on Motorola semiconductor hardware and SourceCom networking software, meeting demands by telephone companies and Internet service providers (ISP) for compatability of xDSL equipment.
